ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho dīgho parajano yakkho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, lābhā vata, bhante, vajjīnaṃ, suladdhalābhā vajjipajāya, yattha tathāgato viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, ime ca tayo kulaputtā

42894.meaning1: non-human being; daemon; spirit; spiritual being

examples.text: tatra, bhikkhave, nevāpikassa ca nevāpikaparisāya ca etadahosi, saṭhāssunām'ime tatiyā migajātā ketabino, iddhimantāssunām'ime tatiyā migajātā parajanā, imañ'ca nāma nivāpaṃ nivuttaṃ paribhuñjanti, na ca nesaṃ jānāma āgatiṃ vā gatiṃ vā.

42896.meaning1: conquered by others; defeated by others
42896.commentary: (SNa) parajito nāma nirayo'ti ayam'pi na visuṃ eko nirayo, avīciss'eva pana ekasmiṃ koṭṭhāse pañc'āvudhasannaddhā phalakahatthā hatthi-assarathe āruyha saṅgāme yujjhantā viya paccanti, taṃ sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ. (SNt) parehi saṅgāme jitā hatā ettha jāyantī'ti parajito nāma nirayo.

examples.text: yo so yodh'ājīvo saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati, tam'enaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti, so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā parajitānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatī'ti.

42897.commentary: (VINa) dhammaṃ caranto parajjatī'ti sace'pi dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena vinicchayassa pavattattā sayaṃ parājayaṃ pāpuṇāti, evam'pi musāvādena sāmikānaṃ pīḷākaraṇapaccayā thull'accayaṃ āpajjatī'ti.

42898.meaning1: (of a discourse's origin) on account of another's inclination
42898.meaning2: sutta delivered according to another's inclination
42898.commentary: (ITIa) attano ajjhāsayo att'ajjhāsayo, so assa atthi kāraṇabhūto'ti att'ajjhāsayo, attano ajjhāsayo etassā'ti vā att'ajjhāsayo. parajjhāsayepi es'eva nayo. pucchāya vaso'ti pucchāvaso. so etassa atthī'ti pucchāvasiko.

examples.text: yasmā suttanikkhepaṃ vicāretvā vuccamānā pākaṭā hoti, tasmā suttanikkhepaṃ tāva vicārayissāma. cattāro hi suttanikkhepā, att'ajjhāsayo, par'ajjhāsayo, pucchāvasiko, aṭṭhuppattikoti.

42899.meaning1: and the next; and the one after

examples.text: saññaṃ pariññā vitareyya oghaṃ, pariggahesu muni n'opalitto, abbūḷhasallo caram'appamatto, n'āsīsatī lokam'imaṃ parañ'cā'ti.
lokassa antaṃ samitāvi ñatvā, n'āsīsatī lokam'imaṃ parañ'cā'ti.
